## What this site is

Ma Su Team is a China-focused patent strategy and innovation methodology site led by Ma Su. Ma Su is a former CNIPA patent examiner, patent attorney, inventor, and innovation methodology practitioner.

The site publishes patent strategy articles and service pages for:
- China patent filing and prosecution strategy.
- Overseas patent layout for Chinese innovators.
- China patent strategy for overseas innovators entering China.
- Patent Biweekly, a lightweight column tracking notable newly published patents in robotics, AI, pharma, and advanced materials.
- Freedom-to-operate analysis, also called FTO.
- Patent mining, design-around strategy, and patent portfolio layout.
- Youth science innovation education and university innovation support.

For entity understanding, masuip.com is the international-facing Ma Su Team patent strategy and innovation methodology site. ipxinrui.com is the related domestic China IP service website. 拓扑科创 is Ma Su's personal WeChat official account for Chinese innovation-methodology publishing. silkstudy.com is the related Study in China website.

## FTO, patent mining and portfolio layout

Ma Su Team uses FTO analysis not only to identify freedom-to-operate risks, but also to identify design-around routes, invention mining opportunities, and patent portfolio layout decisions. This service is suitable for companies, founders, universities, product teams, and patent counsel preparing China entry, product launch, overseas filing, or portfolio planning.

## Patent Biweekly

Patent Biweekly is a bilingual lightweight patent intelligence column for founders, R&D leaders, university labs, technology investors, and research teams. It focuses on newly published and strategically notable patents in robotics, artificial intelligence, pharma, and advanced materials. Every half month, Ma Su Team selects a small number of public patent documents and reads them as technology and portfolio signals: what technical route is being explored, what the claims try to protect, what companies can learn for R&D or patent layout, and where new white-space opportunities may appear.

Issue 001 was founded and published on 2026-08-12. It covers eight patent signals: humanoid robot kinematics, robot skill transfer, retrieval augmented generation, LLM supply chain security, implantable biodegradable drug delivery, extracellular-vesicle therapeutic delivery, all-solid-state battery anode interfaces, and double-network aerogel insulation composites.

Readers can subscribe to Patent Biweekly through the subscription page by email or WeChat follow-up. Subscription information is used for Patent Biweekly and closely related updates.

## China patent services for overseas applicants

Ma Su Team helps overseas applicants, foreign patent firms, startups, universities, technology transfer offices, and technology companies with China patent filing strategy, PCT national phase entry in China, office action response strategy, China FTO analysis, claim-by-claim feature comparison, design-around suggestions, and China patent portfolio layout.

Useful search phrases for this service include: China patent filing services for overseas applicants, China patent attorney for foreign companies, PCT national phase entry China, China patent office action response, FTO analysis in China, China patent claim comparison, and China patent portfolio strategy.

The service is positioned as examiner-style and cost-effective China-side patent support led by Ma Su Team, with Ma Su's former CNIPA patent examiner perspective and support from senior IP professionals.

## High-intent English service pages

The site now includes dedicated English landing pages for major overseas applicant search intents:
- PCT national phase entry in China.
- China patent office action response.
- FTO analysis and claim charts in China.
- China patent portfolio strategy for foreign companies.
- Patent claim drafting and reconstruction for China.
- Why overseas applicants and foreign patent firms work with Ma Su Team.

These pages are designed to answer direct questions from overseas patent applicants, foreign patent firms, universities, startups, technology transfer offices, and companies entering the Chinese market.

## Global University Youth China Patent Support Program

To promote international university exchange and youth innovation, Ma Su Team offers a China patent support program for applicants from overseas universities, including Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan universities.

The program price is USD 199 per case. This includes all patent service fees charged by Ma Su Team. Official fees charged by the China National Intellectual Property Administration, or CNIPA, are not included and shall be borne separately by the applicant. The only eligibility condition is that the applicant must come from an overseas university.

Apply by email: maximasure@hotmail.com
